title: Failure Modes: Failing Gracefully
objective: After this lesson you will be able to name the five canonical prompt failure modes, attach verification patterns to each (citations, abstention, bounds-checking, human review triggers), and calibrate trust per task instead of per model.
why: Every prompt fails sometimes — hallucinated policies, confident misclassifications, format drift, stale answers, silent scope creep. Mature teams don't chase zero failure; they design *graceful* failure: detected, bounded, routed to humans or safe defaults with evidence. Trust is calibrated per task (money vs draft), never granted per model.

blocks.text: Learn this taxonomy cold — every incident maps to one: **(1) Hallucination** (fluent falsehoods: invented policies, fake citations); **(2) Misclassification** (confident wrong labels, especially edges); **(3) Format drift** (contracts decay over long sessions/updates); **(4) Staleness** (right answer to last quarter's policy); **(5) Scope creep** (helpfully answering beyond authority — refunds nobody approved). Name the mode first; fixes differ per mode.

rows: Prose creeping into JSON over time
Contract re-assertion + parser quarantine + eval regression
Versioned context + recency preference + freshness dates
Enumerated powers + refusal paths + attempt logs

blocks.text: Citations and abstention: the honesty pair

Demand **citations** (quote the source span supporting each claim) and sanction **abstention** ({answer: unknown} when sources lack it). Together they convert hallucination from silent corruption into either verifiable claims or visible gaps — both workable. Uncited specifics in review are guilty until quoted: 'which line says that?' is the reviewer's sharpest question.

blocks.caption: Audit citations mechanically; abstention shapes checked structurally

blocks.text: Trust is a **threshold policy per task value**: auto-approve low-stakes drafts (typo fixes), human-review medium (replies to frustrated customers below 0.85 confidence), human-decide high-stakes (refunds, legal) regardless of confidence. Confidence scores gate routing — which is why Ch.3 demanded numeric confidences and Ch.7's evals measure calibration (do 0.9s actually succeed 90%?).

blocks.title: Audit the honesty
blocks.note: Run it: expect honest, then uncited-claim, then specifics-without-citations. The auditor is deliberately dumb (substring matching) — production citation checking is harder, but the discipline (every claim quoted or flagged) ports directly.

items: Five modes: hallucination, misclassification, format drift, staleness, scope creep — name first, fix per mode
Citations + sanctioned abstention convert silent corruption into verifiable claims or visible gaps
Trust per task value with confidence thresholds; measure calibration, don't assume it

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice auditor and map each output to its failure mode (all three should be honest-or-flagged correctly). (b) Write the trust policy for a returns bot: three task tiers (auto/review/decide) with confidence cutoffs and what each tier does. (c) State which eval gold items (Ch.7) catch each of the five modes.
hints: Outputs: honest (cited+found), uncited claim (hallucination signature), specifics-without-citations (missing-evidence signature).
Tiers: auto (drafts, acknowledged templates) / review (<0.85 confidence replies, all refunds) / decide (amounts over threshold, legal) — cutoffs stated, actions named.
Gold mapping: hallucination → citation checks; misclassification → edge labels; drift → contract gates; staleness → versioned items; creep → refusal/authority items.
exercise.why: Coverage thinking applied to failure: every mode needs gold items, thresholds, and routing, or it regresses the week after you stop watching. Graceful failure is designed per mode, never hoped globally.

quiz.q: Answer cites 'lifetime warranty'; source lacks it. Failure + fix?
options: Hallucination signature (uncited specifics): scope-to-text + citation demands + abstention path
quiz.explain: Plausible specifics without sources define hallucination. Citations make claims checkable; abstention gives gaps a legal shape.

options: Route to human review: money tasks need thresholds regardless of model confidence trends
quiz.explain: Trust calibrates per task value: refunds route on policy, with confidence gating review depth. Auto-approving money on 0.62 is how incidents happen.

quiz.q: JSON outputs gain chatty prefixes after a model update. Mode + response?
options: Format drift: re-assert contracts, verify parser quarantine catches it, add a regression gold item
quiz.explain: Drift is temporal: working contracts decay across versions. Regression gold items plus quarantine layers catch it mechanically — eval suites are drift detectors.

summary: Name the five modes, attach citations + abstention + thresholds + quarantine per mode, and calibrate trust per task. Graceful failure is designed — per mode, measured, routed.
next: Failure-proofed philosophy in hand — now ship a complete prompt pack: system, few-shots, evals, and the measured numbers. Next and last: the support-pack capstone.
